_note: Meeting and collection points. Add each place once under 'points', then link points to tours under 'assignments' (by tour slug or by category slug, e.g. all bus-tours). 'time' is the pickup time at that point; leave it null if it varies and is sent on the e-ticket. 'kind' is 'pickup' (we collect you there) or 'meeting' (you make your own way there, e.g. a marina). Nothing shows on the site until points exist.
